channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: I live on the same property as my ex. Our daughter doesn't have to move her stuff around and gets time with both of us.
item.description: Katie Lynch's ex husband lives in an in-law apartment in the same property she lives. They prioritized their daughter, and it works for them.

item.title: An 88-year-old worked 5 days a week at a supermarket. Then strangers raised almost $2 million so he could finally retire.
item.description: The internet rallied behind 88-year-old Ed Bambas, who has been working at a supermarket after losing his pension from General Motors.

item.title: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis says AI scaling 'must be pushed to the maximum'
item.description: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis says AI scaling is key to reaching AGI, a still theoretical version of AI that reasons as well as humans.

item.title: I'm building my AI startup in high school. I don't buy the dropout myth — I'm still going to college.
item.description: Ace Yip is building her AI startup during high school — and explains why she doesn't buy the Silicon Valley dropout myth.

item.title: My husband and I left our jobs to travel full-time in our 30s. Transitioning back into the workforce has been hard.
item.description: Toccara Best submitted a request for a year of leave. When it got denied, she quit her job anyway to travel with her husband.

item.title: I tried OpenAI staff's 6 tips to get more out of ChatGPT — and the model felt far more useful
item.description: OpenAI staff shared six tips for using ChatGPT better. I tested them, and several noticeably improved my experience.

item.title: Trump weighs in on the massive Netflix-Warner deal: 'It could be a problem'
item.description: Trump said Netflix's $72 billion acquisition of Warner Bros and their combined market share could be a problem.

item.title: Surge AI CEO says he worries that companies are optimizing for 'AI slop' instead of curing cancer
item.description: "We're basically teaching our models to chase dopamine instead of truth," said Edwin Chen.

item.title: Young people aren't getting hired — but AI isn't to blame, an economist says
item.description: A hiring freeze, not AI, is pushing youth unemployment higher as firms pause expansion amid uncertainty and tariffs.

item.title: Chernobyl reactor's protective shield was so damaged by a drone strike that it's not confining radiation anymore: IAEA
item.description: Ukraine has accused Russia of deliberately targeting the disaster site with a drone strike, which left a 160-square-foot hole in the shield.
